newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu met Turkish President Suleyman Demirel in Ankara to discuss bilateral and regional cooperation.
* Senate chairman Petre Roman started an official visit to Hungary. Roman will meet his Hungarian counterpart Zoltan Gal and Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs.
* German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel is expected to arrive for a two-day visit to Romania on Wednesday. He will meet Constantinescu, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
Kinkel will also hold a speach in front of a joint session of parliament on Wednesday.
* A German-Romanian business conference opened in Bucharest on Tuesday.
* Defence Minister Victor Babiuc will meet U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen and Pentagon officials in Washington as part of his visit to lobby for Romania's early NATO entrance.

* The government is holding a session to discuss ratification of Romania's accord to join the Central European Free Trade Association and other draft laws on child allowances and social security issues.
* Romania will take steps to bring its land and house restitution laws in line with recommendations made by the Council of Europe. -- Bucharest Newsromm 40-1 3120264
